mainEntity.name: How long does acrylic stucco installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of acrylic stucco installation depends on several factors, including the size and complexity of the project, weather conditions, and the existing wall substrate. For an average-sized residential home, the process can typically take anywhere from one to three weeks. This includes preparation, application of insulation boards, base coats, mesh, and the final acrylic finish. Our team will provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific property in areas like Pasadena or Bungalow Heaven.
